newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS - PRICES REMAIN MOSTLY STEADY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS - PRICES REMAIN MOSTLY STEADY.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady on Thursday as dealers marked time ahead of the August 12 U.S. Department of Agriculture crop report.
"Feed business is probably a little bit better but nothing dramatic," a Kansas dealer said. "We are waiting for the crop report on Tuesday to provide direction."
In the southeast, the use of substitutes was noted.
"Reports of test weight are so good on the wheat, that people are getting more flour and less hull out," a North Carolina dealer said.
"They are not kicking as many midds out of the mills because of good flour yields on the new (soft red winter wheat) crop," he said.
